text:
Lee: Hey team — PR #4289 is ready for merge but CI has a recurring intermittent failure on integ-db-connection test. Can someone weigh in? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pfolio/pull/4289
buildkite-bot: Build #987 failed on stage 'integration-shard-3' — test integ-db-connection timed out 1m23s. Logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood/builds/987
Morgan: I can look — repro is flaky locally but I have a hunch it's a setup race in the test harness.
Lee: Thanks. We need 2x approvers; can someone give LGTM if they think it's safe to rerun a targeted job first? :eyes: 
Sara: Can you paste the failing stack/log snippet? If it's just a timeout we can rerun. If it's deterministic on shard3 we should bisect.
Morgan: Snippet:
```
E120 test_integ_db_connection: TimeoutError: connection to db-master timed out after 30s
  File "tests/integration/test_db.py", line 52, in test_integ_db_connection
    conn = db.connect(timeout=30)
```
Olivia: That looks like a transient infra blip — I've seen this crop up on worker nodes when DB startup is slow. I'd prefer a targeted rerun of shard-3 then monitor.
Kevin: Agreed with Olivia. I'll drop an LGTM if Morgan triggers a targeted rerun and we confirm green. :+1:
Morgan: Triggering targeted rerun now: `./ci rerun --job integration-shard-3 --pr 4289` — Buildkite URL: https://buildkite.com/redwood/builds/988
buildkite-bot: Rerun started for Build #988 (integration-shard-3).
Lee: Thanks Kevin + Olivia. If rerun fails again, let's open a quick bisect ticket and consider a small test timeout increase. Can someone add the follow-up action to the PR? :memo:
Sara: I'll add a PR comment with the plan and create a short ticket if it flakes again.
buildkite-bot: Build #988 passed — all integration shards green. :tada:
Lee: Merging after CI green. Thanks everyone! :shipit:
